subject.title: fix(fal): apply request policy to media generation requests

question: Is the controlled Fal-compatible provider-path transcript sufficient for this security-boundary change, or must the contributor provide a redacted live FAL or external-network run?
rationale: OpenClaw policy requires live testing for external API work, while the submitted proof exercises the normal provider code path but not FAL, a real proxy, or a private endpoint.

options.title: Require external live proof
options.body: Keep the PR blocked until redacted output shows a real FAL or external-network request honoring the configured policy.

options.title: Accept controlled proof
options.body: Explicitly override the live-proof requirement because the patch only connects an existing shared resolver to the already exercised provider path.

recommendation.title: Require external live proof
recommendation.body: Keep the PR blocked until redacted output shows a real FAL or external-network request honoring the configured policy.

likelyOwner.reason: The current FAL HTTP helper and host-scoped SSRF policy trace to his recent merged work.
